files.format: ZIP containing path-normalized public text and unchanged binary entries; private originals are retained separately.

receipt_archive.format: ZIP containing path-normalized public text and unchanged binary entries; private originals are retained separately.

archive_path_rule: For a file entry with archive, path is its member name inside that ZIP. Other paths are repository-relative to this directory.

publication_correction.scope: Personal home prefixes in the newly added report, receipt metadata and archived text are replaced with <original-user>. Original log line endings and other bytes are preserved. Images are unchanged.
publication_correction.historical_hashes: Hashes inside retained historical receipt payloads still bind original execution bytes. The files/captures inventory records original_sha256 and the actual published sha256 separately. This is no new execution or acceptance.
